# Superk audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/superk-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set superk` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `lap.mp3` is cut from "R23-11-Water Lapping Against Speed Boat.wav" by craigsmith, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/craigsmith/sounds/482848/.
- `drops.mp3` is cut from "Many drops of water in a big cave (Karstic system Ojo Guarena, Burgos, Spain)" by nomadas, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/nomadas/sounds/609161/.
